name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Compare vanilla gradient descent with quantum
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Compare vanilla gradient descent with quantum natural gradient (QNGOptimizer) in PennyLane on a 2-qubit variational energy minimization of H = Z0 + Z1. Print energy trajectories for 50 iterations. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
